source: claude-api skill: Current Models table (cached 2026-06-24) for input/output; shared/prompt-caching.md for the cache-write/cache-read multipliers (5m write = 1.25x input, 1h write = 2x input, read = 0.1x input, except Claude Fable 5.1 reads at 0.025x / $0.25 per MTok); shared/model-migration.md "Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5" and the skill's Fast Mode quick reference for overrides
notes: $/MTok (per million tokens). Equivalent API list price at the given as_of date, not a bill (the user is on a subscription). cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h are prompt-caching write rates by TTL; cache_read is the prompt-caching read rate. claude-opus-5-5's cache_write_5m/cache_write_1h are derived from the standard 1.25x/2x-of-input multiplier, not stated outright in the source (which gives input/output/cache_read explicitly and says the model is still launching) -- treat as unconfirmed until the model ships. claude-opus-5-5's cache_read ($0.20) is an explicit override, not the standard 0.1x-of-input multiplier (0.1x would be $0.40). claude-fable-5-1 is the only model with a special (0.025x) cache-read multiplier; claude-fable-5 uses the standard 0.1x. Fast mode (usage.speed == "fast") is a Claude API research preview restricted to claude-opus-5, claude-opus-5-5, and claude-opus-4-8, and only charges list price when speed == "standard" (the default) -- fast-mode rates are documented (as a straight 2x of standard input/output) for claude-opus-5 ($10/$50) and, provisionally, claude-opus-5-5 ($8/$40, explicitly flagged in the source as unconfirmed until launch); no fast-mode price is documented anywhere in the source for claude-opus-4-8, so none is recorded here -- a claude-opus-4-8 turn with speed == "fast" cannot be priced and should be flagged unknown rather than guessed.
